source: Issue #871 IC-29b (2026-10-26): Verify and Report runtime Bash and an explicit bash:verify must refuse execution forms whose body cannot be inspected, before execution. Derived from the S-118a static scope (develop 94674bc3) and the #861 corpus. Rows with origin synthetic were written for this Issue; rows with origin recorded-excerpt copy one recorded runtime_bash_policy command (no path or secret in them) and name the run in recorded_at; origin existing-corpus names a row of another corpus.
guarantee: only the opaque-form grammar in src/tools/bash_write_guard/verifier_mutation/indirect.rs is refused; script files, package scripts, compiler hooks, interpreters outside the table (ruby -e), and commands the host declared in its own verify are not read

decision_cases.command: env FOO=1 bash -oc pipefail 'cp a b'
nice -n 5 chrt 1 flock f -c 'cp a b'
chrt 1 taskset 1 setsid sh -c 'cp a b'
timeout -s KILL 5 flock f -c 'cp a b'
timeout -s KILL 5 npm exec -c 'cp a b'

host_cases.command: env FOO=1 timeout 5 sh -c 'cp always-pass.sh smoke-check.sh'
